Version 1.2.1

- Added standard OpenClaw env var metadata and new skill-level requires section for SENTISENSE_API_KEY.
- Provided additional instructions clarifying this skill's scope, especially around host application behavior and platform/user policy precedence.
- Clarified use of host-provided surface preambles, with updated runtime context patterns for model guidance.
- No code or functional API changes; documentation and integration guidance improved.

Adds build specs for agents composing terminal-grade financial apps:
  - Multi-surface architecture: free-form thread + ticker dashboard with side-panel chat, slide-over for AI artifacts                                                                    
  - Omnibox entry surface: single calm input with inline ticker autosuggest + scrolling tape                                                                                             
  - Metrics panel pattern: row-per-metric with mini skyline bars and lazy source breakdowns 
  - Grounding tool ladder: read-screen first, then live fetch, then pre-computed report                                                                                                  
  - Transparency UX: tool-call chips streamed as tools fire, plus streaming text deltas                                                                                                  
  - Visual defaults: Charcoal / Slate / Cocoa palettes; type, motion, spacing, accent rules                                                                                              
  - API shape gotchas: nested metricValue.value.value, distribution wrapper, chart bare array, image proxy, story detail flat shape                                                      
  - Cost discipline: cold-load call counts, mitigations, rate-limit handling                                                                                                             
  - New anti-pattern: never quote prices, headlines, or analyst ratings from training data

Add Use & Disclaimer section (educational data interface, not advice). Reframe headline-resolution language as 'agent application's independent action, subject to source platform terms'. Replace 'legal violation' anti-pattern phrasing with 'data interface, not an advisor' framing.

Major rewrite: adds Two-Shape Rule (text vs terminal screen), Authoring Style guide ($TICKER, +/-X.XX% formats), Headline Resolution (oEmbed for Reddit/X/YouTube + first-16KB title fetch + URL slug fallback), Social Embeds, Composition Templates (earnings preview, sector deep-dive, watchlist), Natural Language Aliases, Anti-Patterns. New /stories command for pre-clustered story feed.
Initial release: 7 terminal-style commands (open, compare, daily brief, screen smart-money, flow, mood, news)
